data.body: Maintainer approval (2026-08-17): the complete RP-02 design summary is APPROVED. This includes the authoritative thin BindingStore facade; separate repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle-policy, and recovery owners; ordered exact-match retirement recovery; read-only construction/load/preview; preservation of public API, unknown fields, legacy bytes, ticket-sourced lifecycle behavior, and selective fail-open tickets-branch publication; narrow closure of the production all_bindings mutation leak; and the boundary that RP-03 consumes coherent state and typed recovery outcomes without duplicating persistence recovery. RP-02 is design-complete and ready for plan-review-shaped epic authoring after the intertwined RP-03 boundary is finalized.
